checklist.acceptance: Preserve named working experiences and essential qualifications; compare each changed source against its saved baseline. Award year versus announcement, film versus actor honours, loans versus budgets, receipts versus profit, programme versus film outcomes, recovery versus restoration, and Odia/Odisha/Sambalpuri distinctions remain precise. Keep translators, co-writers, technicians and community voices.

Film readings carry complete recognition/distribution context; profiles retain sufficient standalone identification while foregrounding distinct contributions. Inspect DAMaN quartet, Bhukha/Sabyasachi/Aadim, Lavanya/A K Bir and music/Prafulla/Pranab. Removing repetition must not erase collaboration or make credit misleading.

Uttam link promises only material actually at Sabyasachi destination; Learning links resolve to existing Bijay Mishra and Lipika profiles. Link labels accurately describe content; no direct public KB paths or invented watch availability.

No fabricated author compensation or viewer-to-reader result. Existing Amada Bata/NBT recollection stays a specific book-publishing account, not film-fee evidence or typical audience behaviour. No inference of nonpayment from missing records. No new specialist consultation/approval claim.

Delete rejected Mantra tracker housekeeping from narrative while preserving internal evidence; move Gourahari ISBN into its note. Trim redundant interpretation after testimony without removing attribution or essential caveats. Remove repeated TV shared-artists sentence.

Expose existing four reading paths without inventing a compulsory sequence or new articles. Hub/intro links and overview onward option should have concise descriptive labels and valid anchors; full overview remains available.

Seven part labels appear in both Contents with correct hierarchy, destinations and page numbers, preserving approved seven-part order and all readings. Check chapter running titles, bookmarks and no duplicate destinations after regeneration.

Preserve all five effectuation principles, practical examples and unpaid-labour safeguard per consolidated decision; earlier optional suggestion to hide labels is not an accepted requirement. Tighten Give the work room to continue without losing family/book screening invitation, dhaga or final maker/audience question. No time-bound project plan or guaranteed outcome.

New art must clarify a literary/making/audience relationship at a justified pause, not serve as filler. No invented documentary scene, named-person likeness or inaccurate film illustration; preserve provenance, simple truthful captions and existing required credits. Check non-repetition, legibility at actual page size, caption/image alignment, no excessive whitespace or stranded heading, and sensible digital/print placement.

Bind review to final source/config/plan hashes and artifact receipts only after candidate-ready notice. Confirm untouched prose/media remain unchanged, all notes/credits resolve, only authorised additions/omissions occur, and explicitly separate source review from any later rendered checks.
